title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Plan accounts from Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork with Sales Research Agent
summary: Sellers can draft, review, and work their Dynamics 365 Sales account plans from Cowork. Sales Research Agent brings the same account-planning experience - objectives, targets, actions, and gaps grounded in CRM data - into the place sellers already work, and changes are saved to the plan in Dynamics 365 Sales. GA date: March CY2027 Preview date: December CY2026

title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: usage-based billing for agents and features
summary: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence uses consumption-based billing for AI-powered interactions. Usage generated by voice and digital agents is metered and billed based on actual consumption, including AI model processing, tool usage, orchestration, and related AI services. Usage is attributed to your organization and charged through your configured billing enrollment, enabling transparent cost tracking and pay-for-what-you-use pricing. title: Power Apps: Build model-driven apps with Copilot Cowork
summary: Information workers can now use model-app-builder skill in Copilot Cowork to create and refine model-driven apps from natural-language requirements. Cowork turns a business scenario into an app specification and build plan for review before creating the model-driven app and its supporting Power Apps and Microsoft Dataverse artifacts. By handling repetitive artifact creation, makers can move from an idea to a working app fast and spend more time refining the app's design and business experience.
